# Senior Developer Architecture & Step-by-Step Execution Blueprint

Ye document define karta hai ke AntiGravity Agent ek real **Senior Software Engineer** ki tarah step-by-step kaise sochta hai, kaise files organize karta hai, aur kaise tokens save karte hue project build karta hai.

---

## 1. Ideal Workspace Directory Structure (Auto-Generated by Agent)

Jab aap agent ko trigger karenge, wo sabse pehle aapke project ko is clean developer structure mein organize karega:

```text
project-root/
│
├── .antigravity/                        # Agent Brain & Token Saving Engine
│   ├── state_manifest.json              # Tracks processed links, files & token state
│   ├── graphify/                        # Graphify Autonomous Configs
│   │   ├── project_graph.json           # Node & dependency relationships
│   │   └── visual_map.md                # Mermaid diagram of repo connections
│   └── ponytail/                        # Ponytail Sequential Skill Router
│       └── skill_pipeline.yaml          # Step-by-step skill trigger rules
│
├── AntiGravity Insta Links/             # SEPARATE VAULT FOR INSTAGRAM LINKS
│   ├── 01_core_antigravity_links.md     # AntiGravity specific setups & prompts
│   ├── 02_skills_and_repos.md           # Extracted GitHub repos & coding skills
│   ├── 03_graphify_and_ponytail.md      # Workflow, graph & prompt-tail links
│   ├── 04_ui_and_feature_inspo.md       # Design & product feature links
│   └── unresolved_links.md              # SAFE FALLBACK: Blocked links for manual review
│
├── docs/                                # SEPARATE ARCHITECTURE & GUIDES
│   ├── project_plot.md                  # The Master Plot (100% separate from raw links)
│   └── manual_setup_steps.md            # Step-by-step human guide for external setups
│
├── skills/                              # Local Agent Skills (Auto-configured)
│   ├── skill_registry.json
│   └── [extracted-skill-folders]/
│
└── src/                                 # Main Application Code
```

---

## 2. End-to-End Developer Lifecycle (Step-by-Step Flow)

### Phase 0: Pre-Flight Token Lock (Automatic on Startup)
1. Agent checks `.antigravity/state_manifest.json`.
2. Agar project pehle se chal raha hai, toh agent purani files dobara read nahi karega (saves 70-80% tokens).
3. Agent checks ke kya is prompt mein **Graphify** (architectural mapping) ya **Ponytail** (skill sequence/tail) ki zaroorat hai. Agar haan, toh sirf wahi module active karega.

### Phase 1: `/plan` — Link Ingestion & Safe Separation
1. **Input**: User pastes 10, 20, ya 50 Instagram links.
2. **Built-in Browser Fetch**: Agent har link ko open karke uska caption aur tool name nikalta hai.
3. **Safe Isolation**: Jo link Instagram login wall ki wajah se open nahi hoti, agent us par time ya token waste nahi karta—seedha `unresolved_links.md` mein daal deta hai.
4. **Context Clustering**: Agent saare working links ko unke meaning ke hisaab se `AntiGravity Insta Links/` ke andar 4 alag files mein categorize kar deta hai.

### Phase 2: `/resolve` — Quick Human Fallback Sync (If Needed)
1. Agar `unresolved_links.md` mein 2-3 links aaye hain, toh aap bas unke neeche 1 line mein likh denge ke wo link kis baare mein hai (ya caption paste kar denge).
2. Aap `/resolve` type karenge, aur agent unko bhi sahi category mein move karke plot update kar dega.

### Phase 3: Separating The Plot (`docs/project_plot.md`)
1. Jab links organize ho jate hain, agent `docs/project_plot.md` banata hai.
2. Is file mein koi kachra ya raw links nahi hote—sirf pure developer roadmap hota hai:
   - Kaunsi GitHub repo kis kaam aayegi.
   - Kaunsa skill kis step par chalega.
   - Project ka Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3 execution plan kya hoga.

### Phase 4: `/build` — Autonomous Execution vs Manual Guide
1. **Autonomous Work**:
   - Agent khud-ba-khud **Graphify** setup karta hai taake poora project nodes mein divide ho jaye.
   - Agent khud-ba-khud **Ponytail** pipeline banata hai taake coding skills sahi time par step-by-step trigger hon.
   - Agent zaroori GitHub repos aur skills ke folders bana deta hai.
2. **Manual Setup Guide (`docs/manual_setup_steps.md`)**:
   - Jin cheezon mein aapki manual zaroorat hai (jaise API key lena, cloud login karna, ya webhook lagana), agent unke liye exact Step 1, Step 2, Step 3 commands likh kar aapko report karta hai.
